- Grinds two Wheat, Corn or Rice into flour or cornmeal over 30 minutes, or two Sugar Cane into Sugar over 45 minutes. Queue at most 8 batches, then collect the finished output before moving the machine.
- Crafted: Farming: Mill

## Arcane Manarite (Alexander)

- Unique, needs Level 75
- Stats: JudgementOfHeaven 100, Containmentstrike 1, HolyAffinity 1
- This Arcane Manarite contains the spirit of Alexander, a sanctified fortress of judgement and radiant law. Its seal hums with cathedral-light, calling a holy siege spirit that punishes corruption with relentless divine pressure. Spell mutations require the level 100 wizard passives Arcane Engine and Elemental Core; some stones also route support, melee, status, or Water/Earth family effects. Recharge: Equip this Manarite and use Elemental Core to convert MP into charge (10-minute cooldown), or visit Essence Infusion with Holy Manarite. Cannot be repaired by an NPC.
- Dropped by: Dark Alexander (1/1)

## Artifact: Feather of Cluckthulhu

- Unique, needs Level 200
- Stats: DCPercent 10, MCPercent 10, ItemReviveTime 14400, SCPercent 10
- "Ia! Ia! Bwak'gnar Cluckthulhu fhtagn!". Those are the last words recorded by High Scribe Grindleworth before his quill was replaced by a beak. The Feather of Cluckthulhu is no ordinary relic. It is not plucked, but shed willingly—an offering from a god-chicken hybrid whose reality-breaking squawk has ruptured both ears and space-time. Forged from calcium-defying metaphysics and coated in abyssal yolk, the feather pulses when held. It whispers. Not in language, but in eggs. You don’t hear its call—you understand it, like a memory you were born with. To equip this artifact is to flirt with irreversible madness. Your limbs twitch before you command them. Your footsteps echo louder than they should. Chickens—real or spectral—begin to appear in your peripheral vision. Some even cluck in Morse. But with this insanity comes power. Your strikes become unpredictable, erratic, but devastating. A precision beyond comprehension. Onlookers watch you fight and cannot decide if you’re a master or a lunatic. Sometimes, you aren’t sure either. And if you die? You don’t. The feather burns bright for an instant—blinding and terrible. You remain standing, feathers swirling around you in a vortex of vengeance, eyes glowing like barnyard starlight. But be warned: Each time it saves you, a crack forms—somewhere. Not in your body, but in the world. In reality. In the shell. And someday, Cluckthulhu will return through it. Peck first.
- Dropped by: [Warped] Cluckthulhu, Eldritch Poultry God (1/500)
